pack.name: Emberbound: Optimized RPG Adventure
pack.resolution: Download only the Forge 1.20.1 release from each official project page. Verify required libraries and install them too.

mods.name: Embeddium
mods.note: Forge renderer optimization; use instead of Rubidium or OptiFine.

mods.name: Oculus
mods.note: Shader support; install only after the base pack runs smoothly.

mods.name: ModernFix
mods.note: Memory, load-time, and bug fixes.

mods.name: FerriteCore
mods.note: Reduces memory use.

mods.name: Entity Culling
mods.note: Avoids rendering hidden entities and block entities.

mods.name: ImmediatelyFast
mods.note: Improves immediate-mode rendering performance.

mods.name: Clumps
mods.note: Combines XP orbs to reduce entity load.

mods.name: AI Improvements
mods.note: Reduces mob AI overhead.

mods.name: FastFurnace
mods.note: Furnace performance improvements.

mods.name: FastSuite
mods.note: Recipe lookup optimization.

mods.name: FastWorkbench
mods.note: Crafting performance improvements.

mods.name: Let Me Despawn
mods.note: Improves despawning behavior for persistent mobs.

mods.name: Smooth Boot (Reloaded)
mods.note: Optional startup thread tuning; remove if it conflicts with another thread manager.

mods.name: Memory Leak Fix
mods.note: Optional leak fixes; omit if the selected 1.20.1 Forge build reports incompatibility.

mods.name: Chunky
mods.note: Do not install: this is a server plugin, listed only to clarify it is not a Forge mod.

mods.name: Alex's Mobs
mods.note: Diverse creatures with distinctive behaviors.

mods.name: Citadel
mods.note: Required library for Alex's Mobs.

mods.name: Mowzie's Mobs
mods.note: Telegraphed, animated elite enemies and bosses.

mods.name: GeckoLib
mods.note: Animation library used by several content mods.

mods.name: L_Ender's Cataclysm
mods.note: Late-game dungeon bosses and dangerous encounters.

mods.name: Lionfish API
mods.note: Required API for Cataclysm.

mods.name: Mutant Monsters
mods.note: Rare, upgraded hostile mobs.

mods.name: Mutant More
mods.note: Library for Mutant Monsters.

mods.name: Born in Chaos
mods.note: Varied hostile encounters; lower its spawn settings if nighttime becomes crowded.

mods.name: The Graveyard (Forge)
mods.note: Graveyard structures, undead enemies, and bosses.

mods.name: Deeper and Darker
mods.note: Deep Dark dimension and progression.

mods.name: Apotheosis
mods.note: Equipment affixes and long-term loot progression; tune spawner and boss settings down for CPU headroom.

mods.name: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
mods.note: Spell schools, gear, and magical combat.

mods.name: Caelus API
mods.note: Dependency for Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks.

mods.name: Curios API
mods.note: Accessory slot API.

mods.name: Simply Swords
mods.note: Distinctive weapon loot and combat styles.

mods.name: Better Combat
mods.note: Weapon animation and combat handling; use compatible Forge release.

mods.name: Artifacts
mods.note: Exploration rewards with useful passive effects.

mods.name: Cloth Config API
mods.note: Configuration library required by Artifacts.

mods.name: PlayerEx
mods.note: Optional attributes and character progression; omit if its Forge 1.20.1 release is unavailable or conflicts.

mods.name: Lootr
mods.note: Per-player chest loot for replayability and fair multiplayer exploration.

mods.name: The Twilight Forest
mods.note: A complete exploration dimension with bosses and milestones.

mods.name: YUNG's Better Dungeons
mods.note: Improved dungeon layouts and encounters.

mods.name: YUNG's Better Mineshafts
mods.note: Varied underground exploration.

mods.name: YUNG's Better Strongholds
mods.note: Expanded End-game strongholds.

mods.name: YUNG's API
mods.note: Library for YUNG's structure mods.

mods.name: When Dungeons Arise
mods.note: Large landmarks can increase generation time; optional, keep disabled for lighter worlds.

mods.name: Waystones
mods.note: Convenient travel with resource and XP costs configurable.

mods.name: Balm
mods.note: Library required by Waystones.

mods.name: Nature's Compass
mods.note: Locate biomes without external tools.

mods.name: Explorer's Compass
mods.note: Find structures; consider disabling in settings to preserve discovery.

mods.name: Regions Unexplored
mods.note: Broad biome variety with a moderate generation footprint.

mods.name: TerraBlender
mods.note: Biome integration library.

mods.name: Alex's Caves
mods.note: High-quality cave biomes; optional and can lengthen chunk generation.

mods.name: Enhanced Celestials
mods.note: Lunar events add periodic survival challenges; configure event frequency to taste.

mods.name: AmbientSounds 5
mods.note: Environmental soundscape; lower ambient volume if CPU/audio stutters occur.

mods.name: Sound Physics Remastered
mods.note: Spatial audio and reverberation.

mods.name: Presence Footsteps
mods.note: Contextual movement sounds.

mods.name: Just Enough Items (JEI)
mods.note: Recipe and item reference.

mods.name: Jade
mods.note: Readable block and mob information overlay.

mods.name: AppleSkin
mods.note: Food and saturation information.

mods.name: Mouse Tweaks
mods.note: Improved inventory controls.

mods.name: Controlling
mods.note: Searchable keybind list.

mods.name: Xaero's Minimap
mods.note: Configurable exploration map; disable entity radar for a cleaner challenge.

mods.name: Xaero's World Map
mods.note: World map for long journeys.

shader.name: Complementary Reimagined
shader.profile: Low or Potato; 720p to 1080p; low shadow resolution; disable volumetric clouds, depth of field, motion blur, SSR, and high-quality reflections.

excluded.name: OptiFine
excluded.reason: Avoid mixing its renderer and patches with Embeddium and Oculus.

excluded.name: Rubidium
excluded.reason: Embeddium is the selected Forge renderer; install only one renderer fork.

excluded.name: Chunky
excluded.reason: The commonly linked project is a Paper plugin, not a Forge mod.
